title: Smart Ingest Proxy: adaptive priority routing, schema negotiation, and correlation token preservation
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Implement a smart fronting ingest proxy that normalizes multi-format telemetry (JSON, ndjson, syslog-like envelopes) into Redwood's canonical structured-log schema, preserves/normalizes correlation tokens across vendors, and applies tenant-aware adaptive priority routing and dynamic sampling to protect downstream pipelines (Loki/ELK) under bursty load.
acceptance_criteria: Proxy accepts at least three common input formats and emits canonical JSON with standardized fields (timestamp, tenant_id, trace_id, span_id, severity, service, message, attributes)
Correlation tokens from varied fields are normalized into "trace_id" and a deterministic token map is stored for debugging links
Proxy exposes backpressure signals (429 + Retry-After and /health/backpressure) that integrate with SDK retry policies and Redwood routing layer
Adaptive priority routing honors tenant SLA labels and routes high-priority traffic to reserved ingestion paths without dropping low-priority telemetry
End-to-end performance: p95 end-to-end ingest latency added by proxy < 12ms at steady state for 256B payloads
Automated test harness with synthetic burst tests that validate correct sampling and no silent data loss under overload
comments: 2025-01-23 — Triage note: Observability WG flagged recurring 5xx spikes targeting Loki during promotional events. Root cause suspected to be burst amplification from SDK retries + unbounded tenant spikes. This ticket proposes a protective front proxy rather than ripping into every producer.

2025-01-27 — Architecture sync: Decided on a single binary proxy (Go) deployed in front of the ingress fleet. It will perform lightweight schema negotiation, correlation token canonicalization, sampling decisions, and emit Prometheus metrics and traces. Chosen over an envoy filter to allow richer schema logic and easier local dev loops.

2025-01-30 — Design doc uploaded: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OBS/Smart+Ingest+Proxy (draft). Includes canonical schema, header mappings for common clients, and tenant priority config model.

2025-02-01 — Spike results: Local benchmark with 100k RPS-equivalent load shows median added latency 3.6ms, p95 9.8ms for no-op normalization. Memory usage within budget. Attached benchmark scripts in repo.

2025-02-03 — PR opened for proxy skeleton and schema negotiation library: https://github.com/redwood-inference/observability/pull/612. Requesting review from @lina-ops and @samir-infra for backpressure integration points.
2025-02-04 — UX/PM feedback: PM requests a 'dry-run mode' that logs normalization diffs to a side sink so we can evaluate schema changes before enforced migration. Added to acceptance criteria.
